description:
## 1.0.0 (2026-10-06)

### ✨ New Features

* Add patches for Spotify, Kleinanzeigen, Untappd and InterPals ([67b6ed1](https://github.com/2eno/2eno-patches/commit/67b6ed1d5824b2547d7dda757f8ee6d8ddf67681))

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Hides ads in the feed, search results and listings.

patches.name: Hide Pur
patches.description: Hides the offers of the ad free subscription "Kleinanzeigen Pur".

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes the tracking parameters (utm_*) from shared listing and profile links.

patches.name: Block popup ads
patches.description: Blocks fullscreen promotions ("Pendragon" messages) shown when opening the app.

patches.name: Fix third party launchers widgets
patches.description: Allows the Spotify widgets to be added to third party launchers.

patches.name: Hide ad sections
patches.description: Removes brand ad sections from the home and search page.

patches.name: Hide ad views
patches.description: Hides ad banners, display ads and the ad player.

patches.name: Hide context menu upsells
patches.description: Removes "Premium" entries from the context menus of songs, albums and playlists.

patches.name: Hide Premium tab
patches.description: Removes the "Premium" tab from the bottom navigation bar.

patches.name: Hide video ads
patches.description: Disables the video ad plugin of the now playing view.

patches.name: Mute audio ads
patches.description: Mutes the music stream while an audio ad plays and restores the volume afterwards. Enabling "Device broadcast status" in the Spotify settings improves the ad detection.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes the tracking parameters (si, utm_source) from shared and copied links.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Blocks banner, interstitial, rewarded, app open and native Google ads.

patches.name: Hide feed ads
patches.description: Removes the ad slots from the activity feed.

patches.name: Hide sponsored content
patches.description: Removes sponsored beers, venues and posts from all lists.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Blocks banner, interstitial, rewarded, app open and native Google ads.
